extension.summary: LRT Epika - Lithuanian films and series
LRT Epika - filmai ir serialai lietuviškai
extension.description: Unofficial client for epika.lrt.lt. Browse the same sections as the website, search, keep My List and watch with full metadata. Log in by entering a code at epika.lrt.lt/ziureti-tv – no password is stored in Kodi.
Neoficialus epika.lrt.lt klientas. Tos pačios skiltys kaip svetainėje, paieška, Mano sąrašas ir išsami informacija. Prisijungiama įvedus kodą epika.lrt.lt/ziureti-tv – slaptažodis Kodi nesaugomas.
extension.disclaimer: Not affiliated with LRT. Requires a free LRT Epika account. Some content is available only in Lithuania.
